subject.title: Feature: Telegram Reactions - Two-Way Support with Prompt Guidance

question: Should incoming Telegram reaction semantics extend the existing `reactionLevel` contract, or should OpenClaw add a separately configurable `reactionGuidance` surface?
rationale: Both choices are implementable, but they define a permanent public config and prompt-policy contract; repository policy discourages overlapping config knobs without explicit product justification.

options.title: Extend reactionLevel
options.body: Use the existing control for outbound guidance and conditionally add incoming soft-signal guidance when reaction notifications are enabled.

options.title: Add reactionGuidance
options.body: Introduce an independent `off|minimal|full` setting with explicit composition rules, defaults, schema metadata, documentation, and compatibility tests.

recommendation.title: Extend reactionLevel
recommendation.body: Use the existing control for outbound guidance and conditionally add incoming soft-signal guidance when reaction notifications are enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: This issue already received product-oriented review from this person, and the choice affects cross-cutting configuration and shared prompt policy beyond Telegram implementation details.
